description: Opportunity-scoring model for competitor-research insights. Score each insight 1-5 on every dimension; opportunity_score = sum (range 8-40). >= mvp_threshold => MVP consideration. Do NOT just average star ratings. See competitor-research-corpus-plan.md §7.

dimensions.label: Frequency
dimensions.measures: How often this issue appears across sources.

dimensions.label: Severity
dimensions.measures: How much it hurts the coach/player/parent.

dimensions.label: Youth baseball specificity
dimensions.measures: Whether this is a real baseball problem, not generic app whining.

dimensions.label: Workflow proximity
dimensions.measures: How close it is to the product wedge (lineup → development loop).

dimensions.label: Competitive gap
dimensions.measures: Whether current apps clearly fail to solve it.

dimensions.label: Willingness to pay
dimensions.measures: Whether users already pay or build workarounds.

dimensions.label: Trust impact
dimensions.measures: Whether it affects fairness, safety, stats accuracy, or parent conflict.

dimensions.label: Implementation leverage
dimensions.measures: Whether solving it unlocks multiple workflows.
